'''Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to Be a Leek Master!''' (Japanese: '''めざせネギマスター！つらぬけ騎士道！！''' ''Aim to Be a {{tt|Scallion|Leek}} Master! Charge with Chivalry!!'') is the eighteenth chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN060|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Goh]]'s {{p|Scyther}} is revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{TP|Goh|Scizor}}.
* {{Ash}} has a [[World Coronation Series]] {{pkmn|battle|match}} against [[Rinto]] and wins
* Ash's {{p|Farfetch'd}} evolves into {{AP|Sirfetch'd}}.

===Debuts===
====Pokémon debuts====
* {{p|Sirfetch'd}} 
* {{p|Scizor}} 
* {{p|Aegislash}} 
* {{p|Gallade}} 

==Characters==
===Humans===
* {{Ash}}
* [[Goh]]
* [[Nurse Joy]]
* [[Rinto]]
* [[Wikstrom]] (flashback)
* {{pkmn|Trainer}}s

===Pokémon===
* {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}})
* {{p|Farfetch'd}} ({{OP|Ash|Sirfetch'd}}; [[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]; evolves)
* {{p|Sirfetch'd}} ({{OP|Ash|Sirfetch'd}}; newly evolved; debut)
* {{p|Scizor}} ({{OP|Goh|Scizor}})
* {{p|Grookey}} ({{OP|Goh|Grookey}})
* {{p|Rotom}} ([[Professor Cerise]]'s; [[Rotom Phone]]; ×2)
* {{p|Chansey}} ({{OP|Nurse Joy|Chansey}})
* {{p|Aegislash}} ([[Wikstrom]]'s; flashback)
* {{p|Gallade}} ([[Rinto]]'s)
* {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rinto]]'s; [[Rotom Phone]])
* {{p|Rotom}} ([[Drone Rotom]])

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught|catching}} a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Bellsprout}} is omitted.
* As the events of ''[[JN051|Trials of a Budding Master!]]'' were skipped, [[Rinto]] debuts here. The manga presents Goh as being absent during {{Ash}} and Rinto's first encounter.
